question: Do teams score more or less in the minutes after a goal?
answer: No momentum swing. Team that just conceded scores 0.95x baseline in the next 10 min; scorer 1.06x. Restart dips the first 3 min.
findings: Team that conceded, 0-10 min: xG 0.92x baseline (CI 0.88-0.96), goals 0.95x (CI 0.88-1.02).
Team that scored, 0-10 min: xG 0.99x (CI 0.95-1.03), goals 1.06x (CI 0.99-1.12).
First 3 min after a goal both teams sit below baseline (xG 0.74x and 0.87x): restart time.
No sign a team is most vulnerable just after scoring: its opponent's goals 0-10 min are 0.95x baseline.
method: Team-minutes (11v11) by time since last goal. Baseline: league rate for the same 15-min band and score state, scaled by pre-match strength (leave-one-out season xG). Observed/expected; CIs bootstrap by match.
data: StatsBomb open data, 23 full seasons/tournaments (2015/16 EPL, Serie A, Ligue 1; men's WC/Euro/Copa/AFCON; ISL; women's leagues and tournaments), 2,856 matches, 527,256 team-minutes.
split_check: Conceding team 0-10 min goals: 1.09x in 2015/16 leagues, 0.88x elsewhere; direction flips, so no stable effect.

chart.title: xG rate after a goal vs matched baseline
